en.name: Boquerones en vinagre
en.summary: Boquerones are raw anchovy fillets cured in vinegar and salt and then kept under oil — pale, soft and nothing like the brown salt-cured anchovy. Refrigerated they run about 2–3 weeks. The freezing that matters happens before the vinegar, not after: it is the anisakis control.
en.pantry: These are a raw, lightly acidified fish, not a preserve, and they must never be left at room temperature. The cure is too mild to make them shelf-stable, and an exposed fillet oxidises grey within hours. Serve them straight from the fridge and put the dish back; follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F). Salt and vinegar do not kill parasites — that is the single most important thing to know about this dish.
en.fridge: Keep them at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, fully covered by their oil in a closed container, and use them within about 2–3 weeks. That figure is borrowed from what is published for glass-packed herring in wine sauce and cut back hard, because commercial glass-packed herring is a pasteurised or heavily acidified shelf product while deli or home-made boquerones are barely-cured raw fish in oil. Keep every fillet submerged; the ones that poke above the oil go grey and rancid first. Cloudy oil, a sour-sharp smell beyond the vinegar, or fillets turning brown mean they are done.
en.freezer: Freezing here is not really about storage — it is the safety step, and it belongs before the marinade. The Spanish requirement for fish eaten raw, or given treatment insufficient to kill anisakis larvae, is freezing at −20 °C for 24 hours, or at −35 °C for fifteen hours. A home freezer takes far longer than a commercial blast freezer to bring a fish that cold right through, so hold them several days rather than one, and only in a freezer that genuinely reaches −20 °C. For storing the finished fillets, 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) is the practical limit, though the texture suffers. If you buy them ready-made, buy them frozen or from a shop that can tell you the fish was frozen first.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, and keep the fillets under their oil. Use them within a day or two of thawing and do not refreeze.
spoilage: Fillets turned grey or brown instead of pearly white.
Oil gone cloudy, or a slimy film on the fillets.
A sour or putrid smell over and above the vinegar.
A rancid, paint-like smell from the oil.
tips: Keep every fillet under the oil; the exposed ones spoil first.
Buy from a shop that can confirm the fish was frozen before marinating.
If you make your own, freeze the anchovies first — the vinegar is not the control.
Use a clean fork, and never return a fillet to the container.

faq.q: How long do boquerones keep in the fridge?
faq.a: About 2–3 weeks at 4 °C or below, fully covered by their oil. That figure is borrowed from glass-packed herring and cut back, because boquerones are barely cured.
No. Salt and vinegar do not kill anisakis larvae. Only freezing does — at −20 °C for 24 hours, or −35 °C for fifteen hours — and it must be done before marinating.

faq.q: Can you freeze boquerones after making them?
faq.a: You can store them at −18 °C for about 2–3 months, but the texture suffers, and freezing afterwards does not undo the parasite risk. The freezing has to come first.
Reputable producers freeze the anchovies before marinating. Ask, or buy them frozen — a deli tub of unknown origin is the case to be careful with.

zh.name: 醋漬鯷魚
zh.summary: Boquerones 是用醋和鹽醃過、再泡在油裡的生鯷魚片，色白質軟，和褐色的鹽漬鯷魚完全不同。冷藏大約可放 2～3 週。真正重要的冷凍發生在醋醃「之前」，那是海獸胃線蟲（anisakis）的控制步驟。
zh.pantry: 這是經過輕度酸化的生魚，不是保存食品，絕對不能放室溫。它的醃法太溫和，不足以常溫穩定，而露出油面的魚片幾小時內就會氧化變灰。請直接從冰箱端上桌、吃完收回去，並守 2 小時原則，超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。鹽和醋殺不死寄生蟲——這是關於這道菜最重要的一件事。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下，魚片必須完全浸在油裡並密封，約 2～3 週內吃完。這個數字是借用「玻璃瓶裝酒醬醃鯡魚」的公告值並大幅下修，因為市售玻璃瓶裝鯡魚是經過殺菌或強酸化的常溫產品，而熟食櫃或自家做的 boquerones 只是泡在油裡、幾乎沒有真正醃透的生魚。每一片都要浸在油面下；露出來的那幾片會先變灰、先油耗。油變混濁、出現醋味以外的酸敗味，或魚片轉褐，就代表不能吃了。
zh.freezer: 這裡的冷凍其實不是為了保存，而是安全步驟，而且應該發生在醃漬之前。西班牙對「生食或處理不足以殺死 anisakis 幼蟲的魚」的要求是：−20 °C 冷凍 24 小時，或 −35 °C 冷凍十五小時。家用冷凍庫要把整條魚凍透，所需時間遠比商用急速冷凍長，所以請放好幾天而不是一天，而且冷凍庫要真的到得了 −20 °C。至於保存做好的魚片，−18 °C 下大約 2～3 個月是實務上限，但質地會受損。買現成的話，請買冷凍品，或向說得出「魚有先冷凍過」的店家買。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫，魚片要一直浸在油裡。解凍後一兩天內吃完，不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 魚片由珍珠白轉為灰色或褐色。
油變混濁，或魚片表面出現黏膜。
在醋味之外出現酸敗或腐臭味。
油散發油耗、油漆般的氣味。
tips: 每一片都要壓在油面下；露出來的先壞。
向能確認「魚先冷凍過」的店家購買。
自己做的話先把鯷魚冷凍——醋不是控制手段。
用乾淨的叉子，夾出來的不要放回容器。

faq.q: 醋漬鯷魚冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 完全浸在油裡放 4 °C 以下約 2～3 週。這個數字借自玻璃瓶裝鯡魚並下修，因為 boquerones 幾乎沒有真正醃透。

faq.q: 醋可以殺死海獸胃線蟲嗎？
faq.a: 不行。鹽和醋都殺不死 anisakis 幼蟲，只有冷凍可以——−20 °C 二十四小時，或 −35 °C 十五小時——而且必須在醃漬之前完成。

faq.q: 做好之後再冷凍可以嗎？
faq.a: 做好的成品在 −18 °C 下大約可放 2～3 個月，但質地會變差；而且事後冷凍並不能抵銷寄生蟲風險，冷凍必須在前面。

faq.q: 市售的醋漬鯷魚有處理過嗎？
faq.a: 正規廠商會在醃漬前先冷凍原料魚。請直接詢問，或買冷凍品；來路不明的熟食櫃散裝才是要小心的情況。
